messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> Service: embedder-eu triggered: 5xx rate spike (13% over 5m). Severity: P2. Link: https://pagerduty.local/INC0001234
Sam Patel: I saw this, taking it now :mag:
Priya Sharma: I'm nearby, can take if you need to jump to calls. ping me in 10m
Sam Patel: Quick note — errors look concentrated in eu-west-1 pods, logs show repeated `kvcache::evict` + OOM-ish cycles. suspect recent quantized model rollout (v1.2.3-q)
Miguel Alvarez: I'm scaling up the embedder pool (eu) from min=2 -> min=4. Command: `kubectl scale deploy/embedder-eu --replicas=4` — starting now
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: alert acknowledged by Sam Patel
Sam Patel: doing a controlled rollback to v1.2.2-q on 2 pods to test. will post logs. if rollback doesn't help, fallback to non-quantized variant
Asha Kapoor: CS FYI — preparing a short customer PSA: "We're investigating increased embedding errors in EU region; no data loss; targeted mitigation in progress." Happy to send once you confirm
Priya Sharma: I can take ownership if you want to hand off. ready to grab the bridge in 2m
Sam Patel: Handing over to Priya — I need to hop on an urgent customer call. Priya, you're on it. I'll stay on DMs for any questions :white_check_mark:
Priya Sharma: Taking it. Starting post-rollback checks now. Observability dashboard: errors dropping from 13% -> 4% (5m). continuing to monitor
Miguel Alvarez: Scale-up finished, routing updated, no 502s on scaled pods
Sam Patel: Thanks — leaving note in runbook: rollback v1.2.2-q + scale min to 4 while we investigate cache eviction pattern
Priya Sharma: Noted. I'll keep the page open for 30m and will escalate to SRE if it flaps. tagging support: @Asha
Asha Kapoor: PSA queued. I'll send a calm status update: ETA 30m for full recovery
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> Incident RESOLVED (ack resolved by Priya Sharma) — closing page, follow-up ticket created: INC-2026-847
